sourcesNote.languages: English and French (official), then the region's most common non-official home languages: Punjabi is the most common non-official language spoken most often at home in the Kitchener-Cambridge-Waterloo CMA (Statistics Canada, 2021 Census, 'Increasing diversity of languages, other than English or French, spoken at home', 11-627-M2022051, Table 5); Arabic, Mandarin, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Romanian, Persian and Vietnamese are among the top home languages in Region of Waterloo 2016 Census Bulletin #4 (Language), Figure 2.
